articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially rolled out GPT-5 across ChatGPT and its API, featuring substantially improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a unified architecture that collapses previous specialist models into one system. Benchmarks show significant gains on PhD-level science questions and complex multi-step coding tasks, though pricing and rate limits remain steep for high-throughput enterprise users.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Tops Agentic Coding and Research Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra with a two-million-token context window and significantly improved agentic capabilities, enabling it to autonomously browse the web, execute multi-file code refactors, and synthesize research papers. Independent evaluations on SWE-Bench and GPQA Diamond place it neck-and-neck with GPT-5, intensifying the frontier model competition.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude 4 with Constitutional Safeguards and 'Extended Thinking' Traces
articles.summary: Anthropic launched Claude 4, featuring a transparent extended-thinking mode that exposes the model's chain-of-thought to users and developers for auditability. The model demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on agentic tool use while maintaining Anthropic's constitutional AI alignment approach, and introduces a new 'Guardrail API' allowing enterprises to set fine-grained policy controls.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Tesla has started deploying its third-generation Optimus humanoid robots in its Austin Gigafactory for pick-and-place and quality inspection tasks alongside human workers. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and on-device vision-language models for task comprehension, though Tesla acknowledges the robots still require human supervisory oversight for edge cases.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Electric for Warehouse Logistics at Scale
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics revealed the production-ready version of its electric Atlas humanoid, now purpose-built for warehouse logistics in partnership with Hyundai's supply chain division. The robot demonstrates reliable box manipulation, pallet stacking, and autonomous navigation in cluttered environments, with pilot deployments planned across Hyundai and Kia parts distribution centers in Q3 2026.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Manufacturing
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a massive $1.5 billion Series C round led by Microsoft and NVIDIA, valuing the company at approximately $15 billion. The funding will be used to build a dedicated humanoid robot manufacturing facility in South Carolina and expand its partnership with BMW, where Figure 02 robots are already performing wire harness installation and parts kitting tasks.

articles.title: TSMC's Arizona Fab Achieves Yield Parity with Taiwan on 3nm Process
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its Phoenix, Arizona fabrication facility has reached yield rates on its N3E process node that match its flagship Taiwanese fabs, a critical milestone for US semiconductor supply chain resilience. The achievement comes ahead of schedule and is expected to accelerate onshoring of advanced chip production for Apple, NVIDIA, and AMD, with 2nm pilot production at the Arizona site now targeted for late 2027.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance to Expand Brain-Computer Interface Trials to 50 Patients
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink approval to expand its PRIME clinical study from a small initial cohort to 50 participants with spinal cord injuries and ALS, following promising early results showing participants achieving cursor control and text communication at speeds exceeding 40 words per minute. The expansion will also test a second-generation implant with 3,072 electrodes and a wireless charging system, marking a significant step toward commercial BCI applications.
